 "path": "/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-hermes-luna6-high-rnd0/frozen/held-out/play/users/u082/system/state/workspace/programs/task-15c3abeb.py",
 "content": "def transform(grid):
    """Expand the two encoded color strings along the rows/columns of markers."""
    g = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(g), len(g[0])
    # The bottom row holds two consecutive color strings, separated by zeros.
    rows = [(r, [c for c, v in enumerate(row) if v])
            for r, row in enumerate(g) if sum(v != 0 for v in row) >= 4]
    if not rows:
        return g
    r0, cols = rows[-1]
    # Split encoded strings into runs; use the sequence with the most colors as
    # the repeating row-pattern and the other as the reversing column-pattern.
    runs = []
    start = 0
    while start < len(cols):
        end = start + 1
        while end < len(cols) and cols[end] == cols[end-1] + 1:
            end += 1
        runs.append([g[r0][c] for c in cols[start:end]])
        start = end
    # Demos encode same sequence as two strings adjoining across the row.
    seq = [v for run in runs for v in run]
    # Determine separately the left and right strings when zero-gap separates.
    nonzero_positions = [c for c, v in enumerate(g[r0]) if v]
    gaps = [i for i in range(1, len(nonzero_positions))
            if nonzero_positions[i] != nonzero_positions[i-1] + 1]
    if gaps:
        k = gaps[0]
        left = [g[r0][c] for c in nonzero_positions[:k]]
        right = [g[r0][c] for c in nonzero_positions[k:]]
    else:
        left = seq
        right = seq
    # Each isolated marker belongs to a matching sequence: markers for left
    # string are extended horizontally right; markers for right string are
    # extended horizontally left; pattern rotates to begin at marker color.
    anchor_row = r0
    for r in range(h):
        if r == anchor_row:
            continue
        for c in range(w):
            color = g[r][c]
            if not color:
                continue
            if color in left:
                pattern = left
                start = pattern.index(color)
                vals = pattern[start:]
                end = min(w, c + len(vals))
                g[r][c:end] = vals[:end-c]
            elif color in right:
                pattern = right
                start = pattern.index(color)
                vals = pattern[start:]
                end = min(w, c + len(vals))
                g[r][c:end] = vals[:end-c]
    return g
",
 "cross_profile": false
}
